verdict.rationale: PII scrubbing is a fair question for an error tracker, but the evidence pack never documents GlitchTip server-side scrubbing rules or its own SDK-level filtering. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: compatibility with Sentry SDKs, the tracesSampleRate sampling option, EU data residency, a BAA, and organization-wide data deletion.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can scrub PII from error events — server-side scrubbing rules plus SDK-level filtering — before sensitive payloads ever persist
